en: A hand-colored historic postcard showing a central street scene in a European town. Multi‑story 19th‑century buildings line both sides of a broad street, with shop signs on the façades. On the left is an inn or guesthouse labeled "Gasthof zum Amthof" and "Restaurant"; on the right corner building a shop sign reads "Eisenwaren" (hardware). In the distance is a domed tower. The lower margin contains printed captions and publisher information in German, indicating the town name and street, as well as the publisher and date.
